Metadata.title: Mercasa | Wholesale Distributor of Consumer Goods — Grupo Inteca, Costa Rica
Metadata.description: Mercasa, a Grupo Inteca company, is a leading importer, marketer, and wholesale distributor of consumer goods in Costa Rica. Over 60 years in the market, 2 owned distribution centers, and nationwide coverage.
Metadata.ogDescription: Import, logistics, and wholesale distribution of consumer goods. A Grupo Inteca company with over 60 years in the market.

Hero.title: Costa Rica's leader in <accent>distribution</accent> of consumer goods
Hero.paragraph: Import, logistics, and distribution of <accent>consumer goods</accent>, reaching supermarkets, retail, and local trade nationwide.
Hero.photoAlt: Mercasa warehouse: forklift moving pallets between storage racks

About.title: The <accent>reliability</accent> behind every delivery
About.paragraph: In Costa Rica's mass-consumption market, Mercasa is the bridge between international brands and local trade: a single operation that negotiates, imports, and delivers, with no extra intermediaries along the way. That integration is what sets us apart, backed by the scale and corporate discipline of {parent}, a privately held corporation with a regional footprint.
About.photoAlt: Mercasa distribution center at sunset: loading docks, pallets, and a delivery truck

Logistics.lead: We connect the world with Costa Rica through an efficient, modern, and reliable logistics chain that guarantees availability and speed on every delivery.

importacion.title: Global Import
importacion.description: We work with more than 120 suppliers across more than 35 countries, managing international freight and customs to the highest standards.

f1.title: End-to-end customs management
f1.description: Procedures and regulatory compliance handled from start to finish, with zero friction for the supplier.

f2.title: Direct negotiation with manufacturers
f2.description: A commercial relationship with no intermediaries, translating into better terms and prices.

f3.title: Real-time traceability
f3.description: Tracking international transit from the origin port until it arrives in Costa Rica.

f4.title: Quality control at the source
f4.description: Standards verified before the product begins its journey.

almacenamiento.title: Smart Warehousing
almacenamiento.description: Two owned macro distribution centers with more than 16,500 pallet positions and world-class inventory management technology.

f1.title: World-class WMS technology

f4.title: Fast picking and dispatch

f2.description: Coordinated with supermarkets, retail, and local trade according to their restocking cycle.

f1.title: Constant shelf replenishment

terms.metaDescription: Terms and Conditions of use for the Mercasa website, a wholesale distributor of consumer goods and Grupo Inteca company in Costa Rica.
terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By accessing and using the Mercasa website (a Grupo Inteca company), you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please refrain from using this site.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of the site
sections.body: This website is for informational and commercial contact purposes. It presents Mercasa's product catalog, institutional information, and contact channels. This site is NOT an e-commerce platform — no purchases, payments, or transactions are processed through it. All commercial dealings are carried out through the contact channels listed (phone, email, WhatsApp).

sections.title: 3. Catalog information
sections.body: Product information, reference prices, availability, and images shown in the catalog are for informational purposes and may be subject to change without notice. Mercasa reserves the right to update, correct, or modify this information at any time. To confirm current availability and commercial terms, please contact our team directly.

sections.title: 4. Intellectual property
sections.body: All content on this site (text, images, logos, design, and structure) is the property of Mercasa/Grupo Inteca or is used under corresponding license, and is protected by the intellectual property laws of Costa Rica. Its total or partial reproduction without express authorization is prohibited.

sections.title: 5. Acceptable use
sections.body: Users agree to use this site lawfully, without engaging in activities that could damage, overload, or affect the site's operation, or attempting unauthorized access to Mercasa/Grupo Inteca systems or data.

sections.title: 6. Third-party links
sections.body: This site may contain links to external platforms (such as WhatsApp, Google Maps, or Waze) to facilitate contact and location. Mercasa is not responsible for the content or policies of such external sites.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of liability
sections.body: Mercasa does not guarantee that the site will be free of errors or interruptions. Use of the site is at the user's own responsibility.

sections.title: 8. Modifications
sections.body: Mercasa may modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Changes will take effect upon publication on this site.

sections.title: 9. Governing law
sections.body: These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of the Republic of Costa Rica. Any dispute will be submitted to the competent courts of Costa Rica.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.body: For questions about these Terms and Conditions, you may write to servicio_al_cliente@grupointeca.com.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy and personal data handling for Mercasa, a wholesale distributor of consumer goods and Grupo Inteca company in Costa Rica.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body: Mercasa, a Grupo Inteca company, domiciled in Tejar de El Guarco, Cartago, Costa Rica, is responsible for the processing of personal data collected through this website.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
sections.body: Through this site's forms (contact and recruitment) we may collect: name, email address, phone number, and any additional information the user chooses to include in their message or application.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of processing
sections.body:
The data collected is used exclusively to:
- Respond to commercial or customer service inquiries.
- Manage recruitment and personnel selection processes.
- Follow up on contact requests.

Data is not used for purposes other than those indicated here, nor shared with unauthorized third parties.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
sections.body: Personal data is processed in accordance with Law No. 8968 on the Protection of Individuals with Regard to the Processing of Their Personal Data of Costa Rica, and its regulations.

sections.title: 5. Data subject rights (ARCO Rights)
sections.body: You have the right to Access, Rectify, Cancel, and Object to the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights, you may write to servicio_al_cliente@grupointeca.com stating your request.

sections.title: 6. Data retention
sections.body: Personal data will be retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected, or as required by applicable law.

sections.title: 7. Information security
sections.body: Mercasa implements reasonable measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: This site may use technical cookies necessary for its operation. No third-party advertising tracking cookies are used.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
sections.body: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. We recommend reviewing it occasionally. The "last updated" date indicates the version in effect.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.body: For questions about this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal data, you may write to servicio_al_cliente@grupointeca.com.
